scripts.maestro: hash=$(printenv npm_lifecycle_script | cat - patches/*.patch | git hash-object --stdin) && echo $hash | cmp -s - build/hash || { src=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf $src' EXIT && git init -q $src && git -C $src fetch -q --depth 1 https://github.com/mobile-dev-inc/Maestro cli-2.12.0 && git -C $src checkout -q FETCH_HEAD && git -C $src apply $PWD/patches/*.patch && $src/gradlew -p $src :maestro-cli:installDist -x :maestro-ios-driver:buildIosDriver && rm -rf build && mv $src/maestro-cli/build/install/maestro build && echo $hash > build/hash; }
scripts.brave: d=node_modules/.cache/brave && hash=$(printenv npm_lifecycle_script | git hash-object --stdin) && echo $hash | cmp -s - $d/hash || { v=1.98.60 && rm -rf $d && curl -fsSL --create-dirs -o $d/brave.zip https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/releases/download/v$v/brave-browser-$v-linux-amd64.zip && unzip -qd $d $d/brave.zip && rm $d/brave.zip && echo $hash > $d/hash; }
scripts.metamask: d=node_modules/.cache/metamask && hash=$(printenv npm_lifecycle_script | cat - subflows/metamask.yaml | git hash-object --stdin) && echo $hash | cmp -s - $d/hash || { v=13.54.0 && rm -rf $d && curl -fsSL --create-dirs -o $d/metamask.zip https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension/releases/download/v$v/metamask-chrome-$v.zip && unzip -qd $d/extension $d/metamask.zip && rm $d/metamask.zip && SE_FORCE_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=true build/bin/maestro test subflows/metamask.yaml -e APP_ID=http://localhost:8081 --platform web --headless --screen-size 1920x1080 --browser-args=--force-prefers-reduced-motion --browser-args=--user-data-dir=$PWD/$d/profile --browser-args=--load-extension=$PWD/$d/extension --browser-args=--no-sandbox --browser-args=--screen-info={3840x2160} '--browser-args=--host-resolver-rules=MAP *.infura.io ~NOTFOUND, MAP *.metamask.io ~NOTFOUND' && echo $hash > $d/hash; }

e2e:webauthn.command: mkdir -p junit && curl -fs --fail-early --retry 420 --retry-delay 1 --retry-all-errors -o /dev/null localhost:3000/api/auth/authentication -o /dev/null localhost:8081 && CHROME_LOG_FILE=$PWD/chrome.log build/bin/maestro test flows/{args.flow}.yaml -e APP_ID=http://localhost:8081 -e method=webauthn --platform web --headless --screen-size {args.screen} --format junit --output junit/{args.flow}.xml --browser-args=--force-prefers-reduced-motion --browser-args=--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream --browser-args=--use-fake-device-for-media-stream --browser-args=--use-file-for-fake-video-capture=$PWD/generated/{args.flow}.y4m --browser-args=--no-sandbox

e2e:metamask.command: d=$(mktemp -d) && cp -a node_modules/.cache/metamask/profile/. $d && mkdir -p junit && curl -fs --fail-early --retry 420 --retry-delay 1 --retry-all-errors -o /dev/null localhost:3000/api/auth/authentication -o /dev/null localhost:8081 && CHROME_LOG_FILE=$PWD/chrome.log build/bin/maestro test flows/{args.flow}.yaml -e APP_ID=http://localhost:8081 -e method=metamask --platform web --headless --screen-size {args.screen} --format junit --output junit/{args.flow}.xml --browser-args=--force-prefers-reduced-motion --browser-args=--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream --browser-args=--use-fake-device-for-media-stream --browser-args=--use-file-for-fake-video-capture=$PWD/generated/{args.flow}.y4m --browser-args=--user-data-dir=$d --browser-args=--load-extension=$PWD/node_modules/.cache/metamask/extension --browser-args=--no-sandbox --browser-args=--screen-info={3840x2160} '--browser-args=--host-resolver-rules=MAP *.infura.io ~NOTFOUND, MAP *.metamask.io ~NOTFOUND'

e2e:brave.command: mkdir -p junit && curl -fs --fail-early --retry 420 --retry-delay 1 --retry-all-errors -o /dev/null localhost:3000/api/auth/authentication -o /dev/null localhost:8081 && CHROME_LOG_FILE=$PWD/chrome.log SE_BROWSER_PATH=$PWD/node_modules/.cache/brave/brave xvfb-run -a build/bin/maestro test flows/{args.flow}.yaml -e APP_ID=http://localhost:8081 -e method=brave --platform web --screen-size {args.screen} --format junit --output junit/{args.flow}.xml --browser-args=--force-prefers-reduced-motion --browser-args=--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream --browser-args=--use-fake-device-for-media-stream --browser-args=--use-file-for-fake-video-capture=$PWD/generated/{args.flow}.y4m --browser-args=--window-size=$(echo {args.screen} | tr x ,) --browser-args=--no-sandbox
